agent_runs_terminal_completed_ck.name: agent_runs_terminal_completed_ck
agent_runs_terminal_completed_ck.value: "agent_runs"."status" NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled') OR "agent_runs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL

agent_runs_failure_ck.name: agent_runs_failure_ck
agent_runs_failure_ck.value: ("agent_runs"."status" = 'failed' AND "agent_runs"."failure" IS NOT NULL) OR ("agent_runs"."status" <> 'failed' AND "agent_runs"."failure" IS NULL)

intake_answers_state_value_ck.name: intake_answers_state_value_ck
intake_answers_state_value_ck.value: ("intake_answers"."state" = 'answered' AND "intake_answers"."kind" IS NOT NULL AND "intake_answers"."value" IS NOT NULL) OR ("intake_answers"."state" IN ('unknown', 'deferred') AND "intake_answers"."kind" IS NULL AND "intake_answers"."value" IS NULL)

project_tasks_completed_ck.name: project_tasks_completed_ck
project_tasks_completed_ck.value: ("project_tasks"."status" = 'completed' AND "project_tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("project_tasks"."status" <> 'completed' AND "project_tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL)

projects_archive_state_ck.name: projects_archive_state_ck
projects_archive_state_ck.value: ("projects"."status" = 'archived' AND "projects"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("projects"."status" <> 'archived' AND "projects"."archived_at" IS NULL)
